Method of Attack: Supply-chain ransomware attack exploiting zero-day vulnerabilities in Kaseya VSA
Discoverer: Various cybersecurity researchers and contributors including @VK_Intel, @malwrhunterteam, @serghei, @struppigel, @FourOctets, @DanielGallagher, @Ionut_Ilascu, @fwosar, @demonslay335, @malwareforme, @BleepinComputer, @Seifreed, @jorntvdw, @LawrenceAbrams, @PolarToffee, @LabsSentinel, @coveware, @billseagull, @Malwarebytes, @_johnhammond, @DIVDcsirt, @0xDUDE, @jackhcable, and @pcrisk
Impacted Systems: Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and their customers
Attack Vector: Exploitation of zero-day vulnerabilities in Kaseya VSA
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom demand of $70 million in Bitcoin
Phishing emails posing as Kaseya VSA security updates
